text: On 28 February 2026, the ml team started a new Microsoft Virtual Machines resource named vm-ml-loadtest-25 that added $387.07 in extra cost so far. This cost matters because the usual daily cost was $0.00 and jumped to $12.10 daily before the incident ended on 31 March 2026. The next step is to review this spend with the ml team to prevent similar charges on future tests.
